targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["dev_eui"] == "000000000000100d")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_digitalOutput_1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "last_payload_counter")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["dev_eui"] == "000000000000100d")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")

  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "last_gps_available")

panels.title: 🗺️ Mapas de Cobertura y Geolocalización SIG — Heltec + LINK ONE

targets.query:
import "date"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["dev_eui"] == "000000000000100d")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
    r["_measurement"] == "device_uplink" or 
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_gpsLocation_4_location" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_gpsLocation_4_latitude" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_gpsLocation_4_longitude"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
    r["_field"] == "snr" or 
    r["_field"] == "latitude" or 
    r["_field"] == "longitude" or 
    r["_field"] == "value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _time: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1s),
    _value: float(v: r._value)
  }))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _field: if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_gpsLocation_4_latitude" then "latitude"
            else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_gpsLocation_4_longitude" then "longitude"
            else r._field
  }))
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.latitude and exists r.longitude)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "type"])
